blocks.text: Module test A2.1 · The Minutes
Instructions

Week 60 of the calendar, after verification A2-01 → A2-06. Duration: approx. 90 minutes for parts A/D, plus 10– 12 minutes of conversation with the tutor. Work without notes and dictionary; Correct at the end with the solution. Part B scripts are at the beginning of solutions: make them read to another person or paste them into a voice synthesis app without reading them.

rows: Listening: a message in the voice mail
Language: root and scheme, the four ways of the verb

blocks.text: Overcoming. At least 38 points above 50 (75%) and at least 2 in each criterion of the headings. If you do not pass the test, dedicate the week after the weakest unit (look where you lost more points in part C) and repeat the test with the tutor.
A · Reading (10 points)
⁧لُوكَا⁩ : ⁧إِلَى⁩ · ⁧طَارِق⁩ : ⁧مِنْ⁩
⁧أَهْلًا يَا لُوكَا،⁩
⁧أَنَا طَارِق، اِبْنُ عَمِّ سَلْمَى. أَعْطَتْنِي سَلْمَى عُنْوَانَكَ، وَقَالَتْ لِي إِنَّكَ سَتَصِلُ إِلَى القَاهِرَةِ يَوْمَ ١١ يُولْيُو.⁩
⁧لِلْأَسَفِ لَنْ أَسْتَطِيعَ أَنْ آتِيَ إِلَى المَطَارِ، لِأَنَّ عِنْدِي دَرْسًا فِي المَرْكَزِ فِي ذٰلِكَ الوَقْتِ. لٰكِنْ لَا تَقْلَقْ: خُذْ سَيَّارَةَ⁩
⁧أُجْرَةٍ مِنْ أَمَامِ المَطَارِ، وَأَعْطِ السَّائِقَ هٰذَا العُنْوَانَ: ١٥ شَارِعُ مُصَدِّق، الدُّقِّي. اِسْأَلْ عَنِ السِّعْرِ قَبْلَ الرُّكُوبِ!⁩
⁧البَوَّابُ اسْمُهُ عَمّ أَحْمَد، وَهُوَ يَعْرِفُ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ فِي العِمَارَةِ. سَيُعْطِيكَ المَفَاتِيحَ.⁩
⁧فِي الأُسْبُوعِ المَاضِي سَكَنَ فِي الشَّقَّةِ طَالِبَانِ أَلْمَانِيَّانِ. لَمْ يَتْرُكَا مَشَاكِلَ، وَلٰكِنَّهُمَا نَسِيَا كُتُبًا وَمَلَابِسَ. لَا تَقْلَقْ⁩
⁧إِذَا رَأَيْتَهَا: سَآخُذُهَا أَنَا يَوْمَ السَّبْتِ.⁩
⁧سَتَبْدَأُ الدَّوْرَةُ يَوْمَ الأَحَدِ فِي التَّاسِعَةِ. يَجِبُ أَنْ تَأْتِيَ قَبْلَ ذٰلِكَ بِرُبْعِ سَاعَةٍ لِكَيْ تَكْتُبَ اسْمَكَ فِي المَكْتَبِ. لَا⁩
⁧تَنْسَ جَوَازَ السَّفَرِ!⁩
⁧طَارِقإِلَى اللِّقَاءِ فِي القَاهِرَةِ،⁩

Help: ⁧السِّعْر⁩ The price of the product is: ⁧الرُّكُوب⁩ The climb (by car) ⁧البَوَّاب⁩ The doorman is the doorman. ⁧عَمّ أَحْمَد⁩ Mr. Aḥmad(in Egypt) ⁧عَمّ⁩ "Uncle" is also a title of respect for an elderly man) · ⁧إِذَا رَأَيْتَهَا⁩ If you see them, please. ⁧قَبْلَ ذٰلِكَ بِرُبْعِ سَاعَةٍ⁩ It's a quarter of an hour before that. Reply in English (2 points for complete response, 1 if partial).
1. Who is it? Ṭāriq And how did you get Luca's address? When's Luca coming?
2. Why Ṭāriq You're not going to the airport? What does Luca have to do to get to the apartment? (two actions)
3. Who is it? Aḥmad and what will he do?
4. Who lived in the apartment last week? What have they done and what have they not done?
5. When does the course start? What does Luke have to do first, and why? What should you not forget?
B · Listening (8 points)
Listen to the message twice, with 30 Second pause. Answer in English; 2 points per answer.
1. What happened before this message?
2. Why Karīm You won't come to the office in the morning?
3. When will he come, more or less?
4. What do you ask Luke to do, and what does he remind him of?
C · Language (12 points)
One point for an answer. Write with your vowels. Root and pattern. 1. Write the root of ⁧المَكَاتِب⁩ . · 2. Write the root of ⁧يَصِلُونَ⁩ . · 3. Indicates scheme and meaning of
⁧مَطْبَعَة⁩ .

Perfect. Write the form: 4. ( ⁧قَالَ⁩ ) I . 5. ( ⁧مَشَى⁩ ) their (m.) · 6. ( ⁧جَاءَ⁩ ) us Imperfect. 7. ( ⁧نَسِيَ⁩ ) tu (f.) · 8. ( ⁧رَأَى⁩ ) they (m.) Future, conjunctiva, juxtaposed, imperative. Translate: 9. They will not (they, m.). 10. I have to book the hotel. 11. It wasn't easy. ⁧لَمْ⁩ ) · 12. Don't forget (f.) passport!
D · Written production (8 points)

Write about 100 words, vocalized, to an Arabic friend who will visit you. Tell what you did last month (at least four verbs to the perfect and a denial with ⁧لَمْ⁩ ); explains what you will do together during his visit (at least three verbs to the future and a denial with ⁧لَنْ⁩ ); from the three practical instructions to get home (imperative) and a ban. Evaluation: Accuracy 1–4 + Register 1–4 (heading 6.3). Each missing mandatory item removes 1 Point to Accuracy (minimum 1).
E · Oral production: guided conversation (12 points)
With the tutor, about 10–12 minutes.
1. A month of my life. The tutor asks you what you did last month and what you did not do; Reply
with complete sentences and at least three denials to the past.
2. Projects. Tell us what you'll do next summer; the tutor makes you two invitations and you accept one and refuse the other
I'll take it easy.
3. Instructions. RPG: You are at the desk and the tutor is a tourist who has to fill out a form. Give him the
instructions, with at least one ban. Evaluation: Accuracy 1–4 + Fluidity 1–4 + Speak 1–4. The Pronunciation evaluates the tutor; Without tutoring the E part remains unfinished.
